relationships.subject: RG108

relationships.subject: ketamine
relationships.evidence_quote: we showed that a single dose of ketamine could ameliorate SNI-induced depression-like behaviors, which was related to normalization of DNMTs and Bdnf

relationships.subject: DNMTs
relationships.evidence_quote: our study suggested that DNMTs-induced decreased expression of Bdnf may induce the comorbid of pain and depression, which can be prevented by ketamine

key_findings: SNI raises hippocampal DNMTs and lowers Bdnf, accompanying depression-like behavior.
DNMT blockade with RG108 or a single ketamine dose normalizes Bdnf and relieves depression-like behavior.
